acceptance_rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, sleeve closed trades >= 40, and guidance-raise closed trades >= 5.
hypothesis: Inside the accepted SEC financial-report T+1 paper sleeve, covered filings with explicit guidance-raise language may be higher-quality post-earnings drift candidates after positive T+1 confirmation than the rest of the accepted sleeve, so they may deserve a separate paper-notional multiplier.
